text:
nora: Heads-up: noticed quality regression in quant8-run for model redwood-2b-v2 on the 'support-faqs' promptset — embedding recall looks fine but hallucination rate up ~6% vs fp16. Posting sample and proposed labeling schema.

junaid: Can you paste failing examples? Is this across whole set or only long-context ones?

nora: Only prompts >512 tokens and ones with lots of code blocks. Small sample (6 examples):
```
{"id": "s-1001", "prompt_len": 842, "gold": "Return 3 bullet points explaining billing cycle.", "fp16": "Billing cycles are monthly...", "quant8": "Billing cycles are monthly. Also you owe $2000..."}
{"id": "s-1002", "prompt_len": 620, "gold": "How to reset API key?", "fp16": "Go to console > API keys > rotate.", "quant8": "Go to console > API keys > contact support to rotate."}
... (4 more)
```

maya: Labeler instructions (short):
- Choices: hallucination | omission | formatting | correct
- severity: high | medium | low
- quant_only_regression: yes | no
- note: mark 'golden_candidate' if 2/2 labelers unanimous + severity=high

samir: Suggested CSV schema for the labeling job (labelers get this):
```
id,prompt_len,reference,fp16_output,quant8_output,label,severity,quant_only_regression,worker_id,comment,golden_candidate
```

liam: Also add a 'delta_confidence' column (we'll compute automated metric later); labelers can leave blank unless they have a quick confidence estimate.

labeler-bot: Created labeling-job q-2361234567-support-quant-regression with 120 tasks, redundancy=2, deadline=2026-03-25.

eva: If quant-only hallucination >5% we should refresh golden set and run targeted golden re-eval. Also consider a quick mini-benchmark comparing fp16 vs quant8 on the top 100 high-ctx prompts.

nora: @labeler-bot thanks. @samir please shard by prompt_len buckets (512-1024, 1025-2048, >2048). Use 2x redundancy and lead-labeler tie-breaker.

nora: @ops-bot can we pause the rolling quant8 deploy for dedicated customers on redwood-2b-v2 until we have initial labels?

ops-bot: Pausing rollout for redwood-2b-v2 in dedicated regions. Notifying infra team and opening incident placeholder: /incident create "quant8-regression-hold-2361234567".

junaid: I'll run a quick rerun with KV cache disabled and post perf + token-level diffs here in an hour.

samir: I'll wire the labeling job to the QA board and add a checklist for golden candidate promotion. Once we have >=20 golden_candidate items we'll schedule a golden refresh RFC.

nora: Thanks all. Priorities: 1) labeling pass 2) triage top 20 high-severity items 3) decide rollback or quant-variant (8->6b) fallback. Ping here with updates.
